notes.title: Farming Fever Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings, farmers! We're thrilled to announce the newest update for Farming Fever. From heartwarming dialogues to new achievements to added DLCs, this update is packed with all-new features that are sure to enhance your farming experience. 

[b]Town Dialogues [/b]

Ever wondered what your favorite town characters are up to? We've now added dialogues in the town! This means that you can engage with your town's lively characters and see what they're thinking, how they're feeling, and what they're talking about.

[b]Achievements[/b]

We're introducing a new set of achievements for you to unlock! Test your skills, aim for those milestones, and earn achievements.

[b]Downloadable Content (DLCs)[/b]

Finally, we're excited to unveil new DLCs that will open up new dimensions of Farming Fever gameplay. 

[b]Added Languages[/b]

We've added support for Dutch, Finnish, Hungarian, Norwegian, Polish, Romanian, Swedish, Turkish, Bulgarian, Ukrainian, Greek, and Vietnamese languages. Now, even more farmers from around the globe can enjoy Farming Fever in their native language!

Happy farming!

notes.title: The macOS version is out!
notes.notes: Farming Fever is now available on MacOS. Unleash your inner farmer and show your culinary skills to everyone.

notes.title: 0.28 Update
notes.notes:
- New booster added:
Use Cupcakes to increase the amount of time customers in a bad mood will wait. Don't worry, your Freeze boosters won't be lost—they'll be converted into Cupcakes!

- Improvements to the village:
The farms now work better, and some common bugs have been fixed.

- Upgraded Mountain Summit farm:
Enjoy dynamic gameplay with revamped mechanics.

notes.title: UPDATE: Welcome to the Burger Shop
notes.notes:
- The new Burger Shop location:
Visit this wooden restaurant with its vibey design and cook up some juicy burgers, crispy fries, spicy chicken wings, and fresh salads.

- The upgrade shop returns:
Check out the repaired and improved equipment upgrade shop. You can once again purchase the upgrades you need whenever you want.
